## What changed or decided
Two behaviors, both TDD-driven (red → green):

**(a) `.github/workflows/shiki-cca-completion.yml` — un-shallow the base fetch.** Dropped `--depth=1` from both `git fetch origin "$base_ref"` invocations (now lines 54 and 470). Both jobs still check out with `fetch-depth: 0`, so full history — and the merge base the following `git diff "origin/${base_ref}...HEAD"` needs — is preserved instead of being shallowed back down.

**(b) `scripts/enforce_cca_verdict.py` — treat the head SHA as workflow-supplied.** New `inject_authoritative_head_sha(verdict)` reads `SHIKI_HEAD_SHA`; when set and non-empty it overwrites `verdict["head_sha"]` *before* validation and *before* the file is written. A differing model value is preserved under `head_sha_reported` with a stderr warning naming both; a matching value is left untouched with no extra key; unset/empty/whitespace leaves the verdict byte-identical to today. Wired into `main()` between the dict check and `validate_verdict`. The Enforce step now passes `SHIKI_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}` — the same expression the manifest builder uses for `--head-sha`.

**Tests:** new `tests/test_cca_head_sha_injection.py` — 9 tests covering replace-on-mismatch (+preservation +warning), unchanged-on-match, unset/empty/whitespace no-op, downstream-validation-and-written-file see the injected value, plus the two workflow-shape assertions (no `--depth=1` on either base fetch; both checkouts keep `fetch-depth: 0`; Enforce step passes `SHIKI_HEAD_SHA`).
